name: OneFile
author: OneFile
description: Upload images to a OneFile instance and return the public object URL.

inputs.name: baseUrl
inputs.label: OneFile URL
inputs.help: OneFile site origin. Do not include a trailing slash.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API Key
inputs.help: Use a OneFile file API key that includes uploads:write. The key's bucket and image compression settings are used automatically.

inputs.name: publicUpload
inputs.label: Public Upload UUID or URL
inputs.help: Paste the UUID from /:uuid or the full /api/public-uploads/:uuid URL.

inputs.name: keyPrefix
inputs.label: Object Prefix
inputs.help: Optional. When set, OneFile stores files as <prefix>/<original filename>. Leave empty to use OneFile's default date prefix.
